issues.description: The problem statement and UML expect a custom toString() that returns a String. In the solution implementation the toString method is declared to return Object (public Object toString()), which is incompatible with the expected Java override signature (public String toString()) and will cause a compilation/error or fail to properly override Object.toString(). This contradicts the specification and will confuse or block students when comparing the solution to the described design.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the toString method signature in the solution (and ensure the template guidance) to public String toString() so it correctly overrides Object.toString(). Ensure the method returns a String. For example: @Override public String toString() { return "Lecture{...}"; }
